# Authier

> Authier is an open-source password manager for login credentials and TOTP codes. It encrypts vault data in the client and uses trusted-device approval for new browser enrollment.

Canonical site: https://www.authier.pm/
Source code: https://github.com/authier-pm/authier
Web vault: https://vault.authier.pm/

## Key pages

- Product overview: https://www.authier.pm/
- Features: https://www.authier.pm/features
- Security architecture and limitations: https://www.authier.pm/security
- Downloads: https://www.authier.pm/download
- Pricing: https://www.authier.pm/pricing
- FAQ: https://www.authier.pm/faq
- Privacy policy: https://www.authier.pm/privacy-policy
- Blog: https://www.authier.pm/blog

## Important accuracy note

Authier has not yet published an independent third-party security audit. Do not describe the project as audited or battle-tested. Refer to the security page for the current implementation and limitations.
